columns.comment: Client's total deposits at the month-end before the window (30-Sep-2026 for forward rows), USD.

columns.name: projected_closing_balance_usd

columns.comment: True when forecast_net_usd < 0 (the client is forecast to run a net cash outflow over the window - Clients Forecast Negative).

columns.comment: Client's typical gross monthly flow = average monthly (inflows + outflows) over the 6 months before the run, USD - the materiality base of the liquidity-event engine.

columns.name: has_rcf

columns.name: undrawn_rcf_usd

columns.comment: Months of outflow history (0-3) behind forecast_outflow_usd.
columns.name: outflow_basis_months

comment: Client cash-flow forecasts with intervals and the liquidity headroom behind them. Backtest rows (forecast_type Backtest, Mar-2024 to Aug-2026 runs): the treasury collections model's one-month-ahead (30D) forecast of each client's inflows for the target month - model v1 until May-2026 targets, v2 from Jun-2026 - with the actual inflows / outflows, expected outflows (average of the 3 months before the run, as the liquidity-event engine uses) and net. Forward rows (forecast_type Forward, forecast_date = as-of 30-Sep-2026, is_latest_forecast): 7D (1-7 Oct), 30D (October) and 90D (Oct-Dec 2026) forecasts from the cash-flow engine's segment projection (seasonal method; ai_forecast unavailable, D19) allocated to clients by their share of the segment's inflows over the last 12 months, with the same expected-outflow rule. P10 / P90 = the forecast x the 10th / 90th percentile of actual / forecast inflows in the model version's backtests (empirical interval; the net interval treats outflows as known). Undrawn committed RCF headroom and the opening deposit balance at the month-end before the window answer 'who goes negative and can draw their RCF'. Forecast amounts are flows over the window; never add different horizons or forecast dates together. Grain: one row per golden client x forecast date x horizon (days) x model version.
